name: wl93d_checker_addendum_v2
class: WL93D POST-HOC QUALITATIVE ADDENDUM (non-numbered), revision 2. Not part of the frozen WL93D protocol, evidence or labels; nothing here changes them.

revision_history.revision_1_superseded: back-wall checker on E2 T1 (variants ck38 / ck75 / ck38L, commits 29f394b, a8a5340, 18c35ba): the S1 panel lobe at ~1.8 m did not resolve the checker in the reflection (reference LOW parity ratio 0.84 / 0.85 vs ideal 0.43 / 1.14), so the requested visible reflection was not achieved; the owner rejected the scene and instructed a scene change with render-verified visibility. Revision-1 results and report are replaced by revision 2 (git history keeps them).
revision_1_amendments: A1 (after the dev smoke at 32 spp, before any full-budget render): T_identity compares with tolerance rel <= 1e-5 instead of bit-exactly, because pt86.accum sums samples with float atomics whose order varies between runs (measured orig-vs-orig floor 1.4e-7, equal to orig-vs-patched)
A2 (same time): T_e2e excludes pixels whose 3 x 3 G-buffer neighbourhood is not entirely back wall (jittered samples of silhouette pixels hit other objects; the failing pixels gave ratio 1.0)
A3 (same time, presentation only): the shared scale of the texture-response maps is the max over panel pixels (the directly seen wall saturates); figure titles shortened
chain fix: the GPU sampler loop is disowned (it was counted by the job pool and blocked the first dev launch)

A4 (POST HOC, after inspecting the full ck38 / ck75 results): the geometric (ideal-mirror) visibility rule passed (94 % of panel pixels reflect the back wall, 7 + 7 cells), but the radiometric reflection does not resolve the 25 cm checker: in ROI_W the textured / untextured median ratio of the reference LOW is 0.84 (even cells) vs 0.85 (odd cells) for ck38, where an ideal mirror would give 0.43 / 1.14 - the S1 lobe (alpha 0.026-0.075) at about 1.8 m averages several cells. Added variant ck38L: identical materials (ids 6 / 7) and code path, cells of 4 x 4 patches = 1 m (still patch-aligned, no transport or material change), with its own preflight and the same render budget. A reflection-parity metric (median ratio per checker parity of the mirror cell in ROI_W, for reference e2 / h / LOW and each arm's hl) is added to the descriptive numbers. The 25 cm results are kept unchanged.

frozen_inputs.checkpoints: WL92A own s8601 / s8602 (loaded through ops93d.load_family, unchanged); the WL93A T0 family is not rendered here
frozen_inputs.operator: ops93d.arm_eval / local_factors / global_term unchanged; arms C0, C2_src, C2_rcv, C2_both
frozen_inputs.renderer: pt86 (WL86) path tracer and ECRO lookup renderer; the only change is the material lookup at a surface hit (see texture.interface)
frozen_inputs.masks: WL86 E2 masks (geometry / visibility only; unchanged by albedo)

scene.rationale: owner instruction: the scene composition is secondary; the checker must be visibly and correctly reflected by the sharp panel in the camera render, verified on actual renders while adjusting object placement. Box A (movable in the training family) carries the checker; it is placed as close to the panel as the training box rule allows (corner x >= -1.35, panel plane x = -1.5), largest allowed face (half 0.45 m -> 30 cm patches), yaw 0.15 inside [0, pi/2]; geom_ok = True. Camera moved to view the panel at about 45 deg (the camera is not an input of the model). One point light inside the training light distribution (light_ok = True) placed so that the panel-facing box face is lit. Box B kept out of view.
scene.iteration_log: probe renders p01-p05 (64-512 spp, results/probe): p01 yaw 45 deg box at ~0.5 m: blurred blobs; p02 closer, yaw 20 deg: still blurred; p03 / p04 largest face, yaw 0.15, face ~0.22 m from the panel plane: 3 x 3 checker visible in the reflection (reference LOW ratio 0.79 / 1.35 vs ideal 0.6 / 1.6, median mirror distance 0.36 m); p05 tighter framing (fov 32). The remaining softness is the S1 lobe itself (the material is frozen).

texture.surface: all six faces of box A (3 x 3 patches each, 54 patches)
texture.pattern: per face (iu + iv) even -> a, odd -> b; one checker cell = one patch
texture.interface: per-patch material-id map PMAT consumed by (i) learned ECRO (mat_states[PMAT]), (ii) M64 (Mq[PMAT]), (iii) the physical reference / LOW / ECRO-lookup renderer: at every surface hit the material id is PMAT[patch_bin(hit)] (run-time source patch of pt86.Ctx.trace; pt86.py unchanged)

variants.bx38: a = id 6 Lambert 0.3, b = id 7 Lambert 0.8 (new rows from the WL86 lambert_state constructor; outside the training Lambert range 0.5-0.7) -> MATERIAL-DISTRIBUTION TEST
variants.bx75: a = id 3 (0.7), b = id 4 (box A's own 0.5): training-vocabulary states, wall material on box patches -> MATERIAL-DISTRIBUTION TEST; low contrast (1.4 : 1)
variants.none: untextured counterpart (box A uniform id 4) rendered in the same scene with the same seeds (common random numbers)

texture.M64_new_rows: Mq rows for ids 6 / 7 = Mq[3] x (albedo / 0.7), admissible only if test T_mq shows the Lambert rows are exactly proportional to albedo

preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_buffer: each checkpoint's mat_states == mats86 states bit-exactly before extension; first 6 rows unchanged after extension
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_closure: DrClosure83 on ids 3 / 6 / 7: eval(6) / 0.3 = eval(3) / 0.7 = eval(7) / 0.8 (rel <= 1e-5); sampled directions identical; sample weights = albedo (rel <= 1e-5)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_identity: untextured E2 T1: patched renderer == original renderer within rel 1e-5 (float-atomic floor; rev. 1 A1)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_tables: untextured E2 T1: B tables == WL93D I_E2_T1 tables (rel <= 1e-6)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_corr: checker scene: material id from the patched lookup at every box-A pixel == an independent numpy face / cell computation from the hit position (pixels within 1 mm of a cell edge excluded); 0 mismatches
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_e2e: kmax = 1 CRN renders, original renderer (untextured) vs patched (bx38): textured / untextured direct radiance == albedo / 0.5 at box-A pixels whose 3 x 3 neighbourhood is on the same face and >= 2 cm from cell edges (rel <= 1e-4)
preflight_tests_stop_on_failure.T_aware: bx38 changes the model's per-patch material input on exactly the 54 checker patches

visibility: verified on actual renders during the scene iteration (probe images); the final references report the reflection correspondence (pixel correlation of the log albedo ratio predicted by the ideal-mirror cell vs the reference LOW ratio in ROI_T) and the ratio per mirror-cell material

renders.reference: REF-ER, 4 realizations x 8,192 spp per variant (none / bx38 / bx75), seeds 86100-86103 (CRN across variants)
renders.arms: own s8601 / s8602 x C0, C2_src, C2_rcv, C2_both, 2 x 4,096 spp, seeds 86600 / 86601, per variant (CRN across variants)

outputs.sheet: per variant and seed: full frames (reference LOW + arm higher-order term), higher-order term only, panel close-ups with ROI contours, signed reference-relative higher-order difference (shared absolute scale), texture response textured - untextured of the higher-order term (shared absolute scale); one exposure keyed to the untextured reference median
outputs.numbers: descriptive only: region E_H (WL86 definition) in ROI_T (panel pixels whose ideal-mirror ray hits a checker patch), panel, box seen directly, frame; texture response slope / correlation / relative error vs the reference; reflection correspondence; table-level S / G ratios (diag_sg93d.py)
outputs.labels: none. No verdict, gate or label is computed; the frozen WL93D labels are unchanged

not_done: no training, no checkpoint / operator change, no new transport mechanism, no image-space pattern, no protocol / verdict change of WL93D, no full-scale evaluation, no WL94
